info.title: TSukenya catalogue
info.description: Same-origin cookie session; writes require Origin and X-CSRF-Token. Decimal strings at API boundary, legacy numeric storage adapter. No stock or cash postings.

post.description: Create a product. Nonempty dictionary fields must exist in references; category must belong to type. Legacy imports retain their text compatibility.

patch.description: Changed dictionary fields must exist in references; changing type also validates category. Unchanged historical values are preserved.

get.description: Persistent reference entries merged with distinct legacy product values, including default unit шт. Category parentType uses canonical group spelling. No product data is rewritten.

post.description: Create a persistent choice. Retries return the same canonical item and ID (200); new value 201. Requires catalogue edit role. Category requires a known nonempty group.

Read-only server validation of a parsed import. Owner, manager or warehouse role; standard cookie authentication, Origin and CSRF. Maximum 1000 rows and 1 MiB JSON request. Names use whitespace normalization and Unicode case folding; duplicate file names or ambiguous existing names are row errors. Computes authoritative regular and effective prices with the editor validator.

400.description: Invalid request; commit row errors include preview entries and no writes

409.description: Catalogue snapshot or immutable idempotency key conflict

post.description: Atomically save every validated row under the ERP ledger lock, or save none. Requires the original entries, unchanged preview snapshot and a stable UUID idempotency key. Revalidates prices, barcodes, recipe references and revisions. Concurrent catalogue/pricing changes return 409. Repeating the identical committed request for the same user returns the original result without writes; a changed payload or different user with that key returns 409. No stock or cash postings. Historical free text dictionary values remain compatible.

regularPrice.description: Current regular price computed from manual pricing or cost/markup, before promotion; not a historical lowest-price record.

CatalogImportValues.description: Parsed CSV/XLSX values. Decimal strings, explicit booleans; omitted fields preserve existing metadata. Historical free text dictionary values are supported without creating references. No accounting or recipe fields.

id.description: Optional expected ID. Must agree with the unique normalized product name, including hidden products.

revision.description: Optional expected product revision; a mismatched revision is a row error.

defaultMarkup.description: Initial markup for newly created products; omitted uses the server default. Does not replace an existing markup.

snapshot.description: Opaque HMAC snapshot of all catalogue documents including hidden products and pricing settings.

defaultMarkup.description: Initial markup for newly created products; omitted uses the server default. Does not replace an existing markup.

idempotencyKey.description: Generate once per confirmed preview; reuse unchanged after an ambiguous network failure. Bound to the user and complete immutable payload.
